hotspots.title: Howard Lutnick Nvidia Export Probe & Firing Crisis
hotspots.blurb: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick faces mounting political pressure and scandal following explosive reports linking Nvidia leadership to an alleged Chinese espionage sex scandal. As President Trump prepares for high-stakes talks with Xi Jinping without addressing the spy allegations, media scrutiny over Lutnick's conduct and potential removal continues to intensify.
hotspots.affect: This story commands disproportionate attention by combining high-stakes geopolitical espionage anxiety with cabinet-level vulnerability and moral outrage.

hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: Vox has launched its campaign for Spain's November 29 general election, anchoring its platform on hardline anti-immigration policies, tax elimination for low earners, and forced deportations. The launch featured high-profile video support from Argentina's Javier Milei and Italy's Giorgia Meloni, alongside aggressive televised debate exchanges over national identity and border security.
hotspots.affect: The topic ignites high emotional charge through intense electoral polarization, anti-establishment grievance, and transnational right-wing solidarity.

hotspots.title: Brazilian Prosecutor Seeks Rejection of Bolsonaro Annulment
hotspots.blurb: Brazil's Prosecutor-General Paulo Gonet formally advised the Supreme Federal Court to reject Jair Bolsonaro's petition to annul his 27-year prison sentence. Bolsonaro remains defiant about his political future despite the ruling, as Justice Alexandre de Moraes orders further inquiries into the former president's security team and movements.
hotspots.affect: The case generates intense affective charge by feeding narrative battles between judicial accountability and Bolsonarista claims of political persecution.

hotspots.title: AfD Nominates Thomas Berthold for Bundespräsident
hotspots.blurb: Alternative for Germany (AfD) has officially nominated former 1990 World Cup football champion Thomas Berthold as its candidate for the German Federal Presidency. The nomination of a prominent sports figure represents a calculated attempt by the far-right party to challenge established political norms ahead of the federal assembly vote.
hotspots.affect: This story drives heavy attention through provocative populist political tactics designed to disrupt mainstream political decorum.

hotspots.title: Turning Point USA Campus Cane Attack Controversy
hotspots.blurb: Right-wing media outlets continue focused coverage on physical violence targeting conservative student activists following an assault charge against a suspect in a cane attack at a Turning Point USA event at UT Tyler. Conservative organizations are mobilizing around the incident to highlight perceived escalating hostility toward right-wing voices on university campuses.
hotspots.affect: The incident triggers strong emotional investment by reinforcing deep-seated conservative narratives of campus victimhood and physical intimidation.
